name: Carmila S.A.
summary: Carmila S.A. is Europe's third-largest listed property company specializing in shopping centres, with a portfolio in France, Spain and Italy worth 6.8 billion euros at 30 June 2026. With over 620 million visits to its shopping centres per year, Carmila harnesses its expertise in property, retail and digital technology to transform its assets and create sustainable value for shareholders and partners. Carmila S.A. was established on March 6, 1991, and incorporated in France.
